candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} {la : n.Partition} (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)),
  Not
      (Membership.mem.{0, 0}
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (SetLike.coe.{0, 0} (Etingof.RowSubgroup n la))
          (SetLike.coe.{0, 0} (Etingof.ColumnSubgroup n la)))
        σ) →
    Exists.{1} fun t =>
      And (Equiv.Perm.IsSwap.{0} t)
        (And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.RowSubgroup n la) t)
          (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.ColumnSubgroup n la)
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Inv.inv.{0} σ) t) σ)))
